title: 第三百一十三章 谗言第三百一十二章 小人出手
lines: 来俊臣对岳峰突施冷箭明显是居心叵测的，武则天这几日本来挺高兴的，因为武周大庆是她登基之后的大喜事，然而，庆典屡屡被突厥人搅局，这帮突厥蛮子就像是饭里面的老鼠屎一般让人厌恶，现在倒好，在武周神都竟然还有人为虎作伥，帮突厥蛮子？
武则天心中不愉，大臣李昭德便道：“陛下，岳四郎此人少年得志，不知天高地厚，暗中竟然和突厥人勾结，此事一定要给他一个教训，如若不然，我武周其他人也效仿之，突厥蛮子便当我武周人软弱可欺，更是肆无忌惮了！”
李昭德和来俊臣两人今天竟然一唱一合，这场面倒是有意思了，武则天正要说话，他目光扫到了低头含笑的狄仁杰，她眉头微微一挑，道：“狄国老，汝为何发笑啊？”
狄仁杰哈哈一笑，道：“微臣发笑并无特殊原委，只是觉得今日朝廷气氛十分和谐，来中丞和李相两人竟然有这般默契，这可不多见，真是有趣得很！”
狄仁杰这一说武则天也觉着不对劲了，她环顾四周，淡淡的道：“突厥蛮子嚣张，他们进城碰的第一个钉子就是岳四郎给的，岳四郎打了突厥蛮子一巴掌狠的，难不成接下来便改弦易辙，又去为那蛮子想办法对付咱们武周的蹴鞠军？来中丞，您说是还是不是？”
来俊臣饶是能言善辩，一时竟然也无言以对，的确岳峰可是刚刚出了风头的人，就在不久前岳峰在城门口和突厥人默啜大战一场，并且战而胜之，当时武则天听闻之后大为高兴，给了他颇多赏赐呢，这才几天的功夫，岳峰岂能替突厥为虎作伥？
武则天的神色缓和，她摆摆手道：“退了吧，让你们过来是商量对策来的，你们毫无对策，便想着信口雌黄，朕心中跟明镜似的，岂能听你们的一面之词？”
来俊臣老脸一红，道：“陛下，微臣所言的事情是实情，那默啜的确每日出入岳峰的府中。也许这默啜是故意旁敲侧击，讨得了岳四郎关于蹴鞠的秘术，岳四郎自己还不自知为有可能。突厥蛮子最狡猾，而且他们行事不受各种礼教法度所约束，什么下作的手段都能施展，岳四郎中了圈套也不一定呢！”
武则天道：“是吗？这还真奇怪了，默啜还真是日日出入岳峰的府邸，哎，还是蛮子狡猾啊！来人啊，传岳四郎过来问问详情！”
武则天这边传岳峰，另一面则有内卫情报网络向她禀报消息，内卫赵莹道：“禀报陛下，据我们所探的消息，默啜日日找岳峰不为别的事情，只是因为那一日在城门处岳峰和他交手，将他战而胜之，他心中不服呢！所以天天上门求战，而岳峰也恰好习武，因而两人便天天武斗，倒是岳峰每次大胜，默啜竟然讨不到半点便宜呢！”
武则天一听赵莹这般说，她当即乐了道：“是吗？啧，啧，没有想到这岳四郎还有这般本事啊，岳四郎有这般本事，区区一个洛阳令还真让他屈才了呢！”
一直沉着的薛怀义突然挺身而出，道：“陛下，居贫僧所知，岳四郎此人不仅武艺不凡，而且机敏好学，其胸中自有沟壑，贫僧以为其和突厥蛮子主动接触必然有所图。
突厥蛮子和他求战，他则是掌握突厥蛮子的虚实，他日一旦两国交战，倘若他能上战场，今日其用功之处必能发挥功效呢！”
薛怀义这一说，武则天心中更是高兴了，道：“薛师慧眼识英才，不错，不错，岳四郎最是伶俐，断然不会上突厥蛮子的当，你这般说法更印证了朕的想法，我武周有岳四郎这般的年轻人，嘿嘿，他日突厥蛮子倘若敢乱动，我们定然要让他们付出巨大的代价！”
薛怀义见武则天心情大好，他的心情也十分愉悦，要知道自从武则天有了二张之后，对他的态度已然十分冷落了。像以前频繁入宫侍寝的事情，现在薛怀义已经很久没有干了，他心中也七上八下没有底呢！
现在好了，眼见武则天这般高兴，待他的态度和以前一样，他心中的一块大石头也落地了。
上官婉儿一直站在武则天的身边，今天的事情她自始至终都看在眼里，不知为什么，她忽然觉得岳峰不知不觉似乎和她想象的越来越不一样了。
瞧瞧今天这观风殿，这么多大臣，来俊臣和李昭德自然对其不喜，可是狄仁杰等对其有分明是十分爱护，一直喜欢挑事的武氏兄弟自始至终没有说话，而关键时候薛怀义竟然站出来对岳峰大加赞赏。
仔细思忖一下，这哪里是一个小小的七品洛阳令能够有的荣幸？还有，姓岳的武功竟然那么高？默啜三番五次登门挑战竟然屡屡失败，他这一身功夫是从哪里学来的？从来没有听说宫中的掖幽庭里面还有武功的秘籍啊！
上官婉儿反复思忖，脑子里面着实有很多地方无法想通透，而这时候观风殿上的大臣们则是陆续都退下来，冷不丁，听到外面天平公主大声喝道：
“岳峰岳四郎在哪里？岳四郎，你别躲了，快快给本宫出来。好啊，你这小儿竟然暗中帮突厥蛮子，让我们武周的蹴鞠军出丑，哼，今天本宫不治罪于你还当我武周没有森严法度了！”
太平公主这般嚷嚷，她已经跨步进入到了观风殿中，有一些日子没有看到太平了，今日太平穿着宫装，整个人如同仙女下凡一般，气度雍容高贵，武则天正在用笔批折子，听到太平公主的嚷嚷声她将手中的笔放下，道：
“哎呦，这个丫头片子来了！朕还没有责怪她，她先来朕这里撒泼了哦，婉儿，你快下去在门口瞧着点，岳四郎真来了把他先堵住，免得太平让他出丑了！”
上官婉儿微微愕然，连忙低头领命往后面走过去，一路只觉得脸上火辣辣的发烫，不知为什么，她感到刚才武则天那目光灼灼的落在脸上，让她分外的尴尬……
content_en:
Lai Junchen's sudden attack on Yue Feng obviously had ulterior motives. Wu Zetian was very happy these days, because Wu Zhou Daqing was a great event after she ascended the throne. However, the celebration was repeatedly disrupted by the Turks. These Turkic barbarians are as disgusting as rat droppings in the rice. Now it's good, there are actually people in Wu Zhou Shendu who are working against each other and helping the Turkic barbarians?
Wu Zetian felt unhappy, and Minister Li Zhaode said: "Your Majesty, Yue Silang is a young man who has achieved great ambitions at a young age. He does not know the heights of the world, and he secretly colludes with the Turks. This matter must be taught to him. If not, other people in Wuzhou will follow suit. The Turkic barbarians will think that the people of Wuzhou are weak and can be bullied, and they are even more unscrupulous!"
Li Zhaode and Lai Junchen actually sang together today. This scene was quite interesting. Wu Zetian was about to speak when his eyes glanced at Di Renjie, who was lowering his head and smiling. She raised her eyebrows slightly and said, "Mr. Di Guo, why are you laughing?"
Di Renjie laughed and said: "There is no special reason why I am laughing. I just feel that the atmosphere in the court today is very harmonious. It is rare for the two of you, Zhongcheng and Li Xiang, to have such a tacit understanding. It is really interesting!"
Wu Zetian also felt something was wrong when Di Renjie said this. She looked around and said calmly: "The Turkic barbarians are arrogant. The first nail they hit when they entered the city was given by Yue Silang. Yue Silang slapped the Turkic barbarians hard. Could it be that he then changed his tune and tried to find a way for the barbarians to deal with our Cuju army in Wuzhou? Come to Zhongcheng, do you think so or not?"
Lai Junchen was very eloquent, but he was speechless for a moment. Indeed, Yue Feng was a man who had just come into the limelight. Not long ago, Yue Feng had a silent battle with the Turks at the gate of the city, and won the battle. Wu Zetian was very happy after hearing this and gave him many rewards. It had only been a few days, how could Yue Feng make trouble for the Turks?
Wu Zetian's expression softened, and she waved her hands and said: "Back off, I asked you to come here to discuss countermeasures. You have no countermeasures, so you just want to talk nonsense. I am like a mirror in my heart. How can I listen to your words?"
Lai Junchen blushed and said: "Your Majesty, what Wei Chen said is true. Mochuo does come in and out of Yue Feng's house every day. Maybe Mochuo deliberately sidetracked and obtained Yue Silang's secret skills about Cuju. Yue Silang himself didn't know it was possible. Turkic barbarians are the most cunning, and they are not bound by all kinds of ethics and laws. They can use any despicable means. It's not necessarily that Yue Silang fell into a trap!"
Wu Zetian said: "Really? This is really strange. Mo Chuo really goes in and out of Yue Feng's mansion every day. Hey, he is still a cunning barbarian! Come on, tell Yue Silang to come and ask for details!"
Wu Zetian reported to Yue Feng, and on the other side, the internal guard intelligence network reported the news to her. Internal guard Zhao Ying said: "Your Majesty, according to the information we have found, Mo Chuo was looking for Yue Feng every day for no other reason. It was just because he was at the city gate that day. Chu Yuefeng fought with him and defeated him, but he was dissatisfied! So he came to fight every day, and Yue Feng happened to be practicing martial arts, so the two of them fought every day, but every time Yue Feng won, Mochu couldn't get any advantage!"
When Wu Zetian heard what Zhao Ying said, she immediately said happily: "Really? Tsk, tut, I didn't expect Yue Silang to have such ability. Yue Silang has such ability, but a mere Luoyang order really made him lose his talent!"
Xue Huaiyi, who had always been calm, suddenly stepped forward and said: "Your Majesty, as the poor monk knows, Yue Silang is not only extraordinary in martial arts, but also agile and eager to learn. There is a gap in his heart. The poor monk thinks that he must have some agenda when he comes into contact with the Turkic barbarians.
The Turkic barbarians wanted to fight with him, but he knew the truth about the Turkic barbarians. Once the two countries went to war in the future, if he could go to the battlefield, his efforts today would definitely be effective! "
Wu Zetian was even more happy when Xue Huaiyi said this, and said: "Master Xue has an eye for talents, yes, yes, Yue Silang is the smartest, and he will definitely not be fooled by the Turkic barbarians. What you said further confirms my idea. I have young people like Yue Silang in Wuzhou. Hehe, if the Turkic barbarians dare to mess around in the future, we will definitely make them pay a huge price!"
Seeing that Wu Zetian was in a good mood, Xue Huaiyi was also in a very happy mood. You must know that since Wu Zetian had two pieces, his attitude towards him has been very cold. For example, Xue Huaiyi had not done it for a long time, as he frequently went to the palace to sleep in the palace before, and he was also worried about it!
Now that he was fine, seeing Wu Zetian so happy and treating him with the same attitude as before, a big stone fell from his heart.
Shangguan Wan'er has been standing by Wu Zetian's side. She has seen today's events from beginning to end. For some reason, she suddenly feels that Yue Feng is becoming more and more different from what she imagined.
Look at the Guanfeng Hall today. There are so many ministers. Lai Junchen and Li Zhaode are naturally not happy with them. However, Di Renjie and others clearly love them very much. The Wu brothers who always like to stir up trouble have not spoken from the beginning to the end. At the critical moment, Xue Huaiyi actually stood up and praised Yue Feng.
Think about it carefully, how can this be the honor that a small seventh-grade Luoyang order can have? Also, the martial arts surnamed Yue is so high? Mo Chui repeatedly failed to challenge him. Where did he learn this skill? I have never heard that there are secret books of martial arts in the Ye Youting in the palace!
Shangguan Wan'er thought over and over again, and there were really many things in her mind that she couldn't think through. At this time, the ministers in the Guanfeng Palace retreated one after another. Suddenly, she heard Princess Tianping shouting loudly outside:
"Where is Yue Feng Yue Si Lang? Yue Si Lang, stop hiding and come out to me as soon as possible. Okay, you kid actually secretly helped the Turkic barbarians and made our Cuju Army of Wu Zhou look embarrassed. Humph, if I don't punish you today, you still think that Wu Zhou doesn't have strict laws!"
Princess Taiping was shouting like this. She had already stepped into the Guanfeng Hall. She had not seen Taiping for some days. Today, Taiping was wearing palace clothes. She looked like a fairy descending to earth, with a graceful and noble demeanor. Wu Zetian was reviewing the folds with a pen. When she heard Princess Taiping's shouting, she put down the pen in her hand and said:
"Oh, this girl is here! I haven't blamed her yet, but she came to my place to act mischievous first. Wan'er, please go down and watch at the door. If Yue Silang really comes, block him first, lest Taiping make him look embarrassed!"
Shangguan Wan'er was slightly stunned. She quickly lowered her head and followed the order and walked back. She felt her face was burning all the way. For some reason, she felt Wu Zetian's scorching gaze on her face just now, which made her feel extremely embarrassed...
